init.title: Configure language model profile (Basic Settings)
init.description: Create a reusable language model profile. Conversation agents and AI tasks select one primary profile and optional fallbacks.

data_description.model: Model name as understood by the configured OpenAI-compatible provider.
data_description.temperature: Controls response randomness. Leave empty to use the provider or model default.
data_description.thinking: Optional reasoning effort if supported by the model (levels map to the closest available value).
data_description.configure_advanced_model_settings: Open a second step for token and iteration limits, sampling, timeout, tool-call behavior, seed, penalties, and request body overrides.

model_settings.title: Configure language model profile (Advanced model settings)
model_settings.description: Set advanced model parameter values for this profile. Leave fields empty to use provider defaults.

data_description.max_tokens: Maximum tokens the model may generate per response. Must be a positive integer.
data_description.max_iterations: Maximum Pydantic AI agent request iterations for one run. Must be a positive integer. Leave empty to use the conversation or AI task default.
data_description.top_p: Nucleus sampling value. Leave empty to use the provider default.
data_description.timeout: Request timeout in seconds. Must be positive. If empty, validation uses the integration default timeout.
data_description.parallel_tool_calls: Allow the model/provider to make tool calls in parallel when supported.
data_description.seed: Optional non-negative integer seed for providers that support deterministic sampling.
data_description.presence_penalty: Penalty for introducing tokens already present in the conversation. Provider support and ranges vary.
data_description.frequency_penalty: Penalty based on token frequency in the conversation. Provider support and ranges vary.
data_description.extra_body: Provider-specific request body fields, one per line, using 'key: JSON value' format. Strings must be quoted.

error.invalid_integer: Enter an integer value in this field.
error.invalid_key_value: Enter one key/value pair per line using 'key: JSON value'.
error.invalid_number: Enter a valid number in this field.
error.model_list_unavailable: The provider model list could not be loaded. Enter the model name manually.
error.positive_number: Enter a number greater than zero.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while validating the provider. Check Home Assistant logs for details.

init.title: Configure AI task
init.description: Name this AI task and choose its language model profile for Home Assistant data generation.

data_description.mcp_server_ids: Optional MCP servers this AI task may use. Only enabled tools will be made available.
data_description.web_fetch_enabled: Allow this AI task to fetch web page content from URLs.
data_description.skills: Optional local skills this AI task may load from the provider skills folder.
data_description.fallback_model_subentry_ids: Optional ordered fallback language model profiles to try when the primary model has a retryable provider or usage-limit failure.
data_description.output_mode: Tool output is the default and works with providers that support tool calls. Native uses the provider's JSON schema support. Prompted asks for JSON in the prompt and validates the result.
